The customer-provided fully qualified domain name associated with the member.
The workload configuration of the member. Set at creation and immutable thereafter; to change the workload, delete and recreate the member.

The Azure Resource Manager resource ID of the Azure Container Instances (ACI) resource backing this member's sandbox. Starting in API version `2026-10-07-preview`, this identifies the parent SandboxGroup -- the enrollment boundary associated with the fabric through a ClusterAssociation -- rather than the individual container group.
The Kubernetes workload enrolled as this member. Reported when the workload is discovered in the enrolled cluster; member identity derives from the fabric and member name alone.
The API group and version of the workload, for example `apps/v1`.
The kind of the workload, for example `Deployment`.
The name of the workload.
The namespace the workload runs in.
The container image to run for the workload.
The image content digest used to pin an exact image version.
The policy controlling when the image is pulled.
The image reference URI (e.g., registry/repository:tag).
The compute resources allocated to the workload.
The amount of CPU to allocate to the workload.
The amount of disk to allocate to the workload.
The amount of memory to allocate to the workload.

The unique identifier (GUID) assigned to the member when it is created. For most workload types this is assigned by the resource provider and is read-only. Starting in API version `2026-10-07-preview`, ACI workloads instead supply this value at creation: the ACI resource provider generates the GUID for the sandbox and this field is immutable afterward.
